quote.text: The leads are the asset. A paused campaign and an unworked list are the same thing — money sitting on the table because nobody followed up.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls booked and zero prospect replies in 48 hours. The FB campaign is still showing PAUSED after $719 spent, so paid is dark. First move: confirm the Capital One payment flag isn't the card funding ads, then either relaunch at $35/day or run a full outbound day against every unbooked lead.
focus: Campaign still reads PAUSED after ~$719 spent over the run and still zero closes. Relaunch the FB campaign at $35/day this morning, or consciously move that budget to outbound — but don't leave the only paid channel dark a third day.

Capital One flagged a payment that 'wasn't completed' overnight plus a separate transaction notice, with AutoPay scheduled for Jun 27. Verify it's not the card funding the FB Ads account — a silent decline keeps the campaign from spending even after you unpause it. Two-minute check.

27+ leads at ~$17 CPL, 0 closed, and the inbox is empty of prospects, so today is an outbound day. Run a personal text-and-call pass on every unbooked GHL lead with a direct booking link, then confirm the 9 AM auto-post hit all 16 FB groups.
gmail_summary: Inbox clear — no prospect replies or warm conversations in the last 48 hours. Nothing business-relevant to Novaro hit the inbox. The one item worth a glance is a Capital One alert that a payment 'wasn't completed' plus a recent-transaction notice — confirm it isn't the card billing the FB Ads account. Everything else is personal or routine: a telehealth-portal forms reminder, a Google Business Profile prompt for Clear View, plus FanDuel/DraftKings/Robinhood and newsletter noise. No prospect action needed on email — today's work is outbound, not inbox.
